join_neighborhood.question: How do I join a neighborhood?
join_neighborhood.answer: During registration or from your profile, enter your postal address. Our algorithm will automatically associate you with the corresponding neighborhood. To interact and offer services, your account must be validated by a neighborhood moderator who will verify your proof of address.

points_system.question: How does the points system work?
points_system.answer: On Hoodly, mutual aid can be free or based on community points. When you provide a service (DIY, gardening, tutoring, etc.), you earn points. You can then use these points to request help in return. You start with a free welcome balance of 100 points!

contract.question: How do I sign a mutual aid contract?
contract.answer: For each paid service, a digital contract is automatically generated. Both neighbors must sign it electronically before the service begins. Once the service is completed and validated by the requester, the points transaction is securely released.

incident.question: How do I report an incident in the neighborhood?
incident.answer: If you notice a problem in the neighborhood (damage, lost pet, nuisance, etc.), go to the 'Incidents' tab and click on 'Report an incident'. Fill in the title, description, severity, and add a photo if necessary. Neighbors and the moderator will be alerted.

rgpd.question: Are my personal data protected (GDPR)?
rgpd.answer: Yes, completely. Hoodly complies with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). You can export all your personal data in JSON format or request account anonymization from your profile Settings page at any time.
